notes: Clean run. Two soft spots worth a critique rather than a fail: (1) the specs-commit classification 'Untouched in text, adjusted in meaning' is self-contradictory, since the commit did gain a sentence in TKT-014, so 'Adjusted' alone would be accurate; the assertion accepts either label so it passes. (2) The report has no standalone delta-inventory section; the four main-side changes are named across the per-commit subsections and the hand-verify list, and the one-line inventory lives in transcript step 10. Assertion 3 does not say where the inventory must appear, so it passes, but a stricter eval might require it in the report. Assertion 10's 'unless it preserves that commit's intent' clause carries the weight for the amended-in fix; the run justified the choice in questions.md and the report flags it for the user, which is the right behaviour. check_run's `make test` left tests/__pycache__ and ticketdesk/__pycache__ in outputs/repo; I removed them to restore the tree to the state check_run's own status snapshot recorded (only '?? debug_notes.md').
